text:
alex: Heads up — the new infra/grafana dashboard is spamming alerts during deploys. Can we review routing + suppression before we flip it to prod? seeing repeated alert storms. @maya @sanjay

maya: Link to the dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/xyZ12/new-infra-dashboard?orgId=1 :eyes:
Where to look for traces: Jaeger at https://jaeger.redwood.ai/search, logs are in Loki (loki.redwood.ai).
I think a suppress-on-deploy window will help — we already have CI hooks that can call PD to silence.

sanjay: Agreed. Proposal: route these alerts to `team/infra-oncall` first, escalate to `team/sre-lead` after 15m, and add a `suppress_on_deploy` tag so CI can auto-silence during releases.
Example alert annotations to add:
```yaml
alert: HighErrorRate
expr: job:request_errors:rate5m > 0.05
labels:
  severity: critical
  suppress_on_deploy: "true"
annotations:
  runbook: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/high-error-rate
```

chris: +1 to runbook annotation. also recommend a 5min dedupe window on the alert rule (so flapping doesn't spam PD).

oncall-bot: quick tip: you can temporarily silence a PD policy with `/pd silence infra-escalation 30m` from Slack. :information_source:

maya: Can CI post to PD API to create silence automatically? If so we should add that step to the release job. Example curl that CI can use:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.pagerduty.com/alerts/silence" -H "Authorization: Token token=$PD_TOKEN" -d '{"service": "infra-alerts", "duration": 1800}'
```

pagerduty-bot: Current escalation policy `infra-escalation` routes -> infra-oncall (0m), sre-lead (15m), engineering-manager (60m). Auto-ack dedupe enabled.

sanjay: I'll open a PR to add the label + update routing. Will also add a short alertmanager dedupe config and a CI job to call PD silence during deployment. ping me for review once CI job is ready.

alex: perfect — thanks. If we can get the PR + CI change before tomorrow's deploy that would be ideal. :thumbsup:

chris: lgtm, happy to review the PR.

maya: filing a small follow-up ticket to add the Jaeger link to the dashboard panels so folks have direct traces.

alex: awesome — let's keep this thread for follow-ups.
